FN-QN23955-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 166
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/17/2025
Senate Bill 166 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of: (1) local boards
of education and the governing bodies of public institutions of higher education to determine the
display of the Ten Commandments in each school/institution, purchased with donated funds; (2)
the State Department of Education to identify a list of free resources available to local boards of
education; and (3) the State Board and Education and the Alabama Commission on Higher
Education to adopt rules pursuant to the provisions of this bill.

FN-QN23955-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 166
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/09/2025
Senate Bill 166 as reported by the Committee on Education Policy would increase the
administrative obligations of: (1) local boards of education to determine the display of the Ten
Commandments in each school, purchased with donated funds or acceptance of donated
displays; (2) the State Department of Education to identify a list of free resources available to
local boards of education; and (3) the State Board and Education to adopt rules pursuant to the
provisions of this bill.
